The '''2023–24 season''' was the 138th season in the history of [[Luton Town F.C.|Luton Town]] and their first ever season in the [[Premier League]].<ref name="A Brief History of Luton Town FC">{{cite web |title=A Brief History of Luton Town FC |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/club/club-history/ |publisher=Luton Town F.C.}}</ref> It was the club's first return to the top flight of English football since the [[1991–92 Football League First Division|1991–92 season]].<ref name="A Brief History of Luton Town FC"/> In addition to the [[2023–24 Premier League|domestic league]], the club also participated in the [[2023–24 FA Cup|FA Cup]] and the [[2023–24 EFL Cup|EFL Cup]].

Luton were relegated from the Premier League on the final day of the season following a 4–2 home loss to [[Fulham F.C.|Fulham]], combined with results elsewhere.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.premierleague.com/news/4016996|title=Luton relegated after defeat to Fulham|publisher=Premier League|date=19 May 2024|access-date=19 May 2024}}</ref>

==Pre-season and friendlies==
On 4 July, the ''Hatters'' announced their first pre-season friendly, against [[Ipswich Town F.C.|Ipswich Town]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Hatters to face Ipswich Town in pre-season |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/july/pre-season-fixtures/ |access-date=4 July 2023 |publisher=Luton Town FC |date=4 July 2023}}</ref> Three days later, a second was added, against [[Sheffield Wednesday F.C.|Sheffield Wednesday]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Town travel to Sheffield Wednesday for pre-season friendly |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/july/sheffield-wednesday/ |access-date=8 July 2023 |publisher=Luton Town FC |date=7 July 2023}}</ref> A third was added, against [[Wolverhampton Wanderers F.C.|Wolverhampton Wanderers]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Town travel to Wolves for August pre-season friendly! |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/july/wolves-friendly/ |access-date=11 July 2023 |publisher=Luton Town FC |date=11 July 2023}}</ref> The club's final friendly was confirmed to be against [[VfL Bochum]] in a double-header.<ref>{{cite news |title=Hatters to face German side VfL Bochum in final friendlies! |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/july/bochum/ |access-date=17 July 2023 |publisher=Luton Town FC |date=17 July 2023}}</ref>

====Abandoned match with Bournemouth====
On 16 December 2023, during the match away against [[AFC Bournemouth|Bournemouth]], Luton defender [[Tom Lockyer]] collapsed due to a cardiac arrest in the 59th minute of the match resulting in the match being abandoned in the 65th minute.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.nbcsports.com/soccer/news/luton-captain-tom-lockyer-collapses-during-game-at-bournemouth|title=Tom Lockyer suffers cardiac arrest as Bournemouth vs Luton abandoned|publisher=NBC Sports|date=16 December 2023|access-date=16 December 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231217004252/https://www.nbcsports.com/soccer/news/luton-captain-tom-lockyer-collapses-during-game-at-bournemouth|archive-date=17 December 2023}}</ref>
On 20 December 2023, the Premier League ruled the match would be replayed in full at a later date.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.premierleague.com/news/3830154|title=Premier League statement on AFC Bournemouth v Luton|publisher=Premier League|date=20 December 2023|access-date=20 December 2023|archive-date=20 December 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231220185742/https://www.premierleague.com/news/3830154|url-status=live}}</ref> On 7 February 2024, it was announced that the rearranged fixture would take place on 13 March 2024.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.afcb.co.uk/news/first-team/new-date-set-for-luton-home-game/|title=New Date Set For Luton Home Game|publisher=AFC Bournemouth|date=7 February 2024|access-date=7 February 2024|archive-date=7 February 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240207174336/https://www.afcb.co.uk/news/first-team/new-date-set-for-luton-home-game/|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== FA Cup ===
{{main|2023–24 FA Cup}}

As a Premier League side, Luton entered in the third round, and were drawn at home to [[EFL League One]] club [[Bolton Wanderers F.C.|Bolton Wanderers]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Hatters to host Bolton in FA Cup third round |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/december/bolton-in-the-cup/ |access-date=4 December 2023 |publisher=Luton Town F.C. |date=3 December 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Date and ticket prices confirmed for Bolton tie |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/december/date-and-ticket-prices-confirmed-for-bolton-tie/ |access-date=8 December 2023 |publisher=Luton Town F.C. |date=8 December 2023}}</ref> In the fifth round, they were drawn at home to the holders, [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Hatters host holders Man City in fifth round |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2024/january/fifth-round-draw/ |access-date=29 January 2024 |publisher=Luton Town FC |date=28 January 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Man City tie to be televised on ITV |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2024/february/man-city-fa-cup-tie-televised/ |access-date=7 February 2024 |publisher=Luton Town FC |date=2 February 2024}}</ref>

=== EFL Cup ===
{{main|2023–24 EFL Cup}}

Luton entered the competition in the second round, and were drawn at home to [[Gillingham F.C.|Gillingham]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Carabao Cup Second Round opponent confirmed! |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/august/carabao-cup-second-round/ |access-date=10 August 2023 |publisher=Luton Town F.C. |date=9 August 2023}}</ref> They were then drawn away to [[Exeter City F.C.|Exeter City]] in the third round.<ref>{{cite news |title=Carabao Cup third round opponent confirmed! |url=https://www.lutontown.co.uk/news/2023/august/carabao-cup-third-round/ |access-date=30 August 2023 |publisher=Luton Town F.C. |date=30 August 2023}}</ref>
